owner_instruction: 两小时合盖子，就不测试了，你自己review一遍得了。

observations.detail: Outbound polling commits ciphertext to the local queue before the helper spool receipt. Connection retries reauthenticate, with 1 to 60 second backoff. Each session pulls relay waiting messages before draining the local outbound queue.

An exclusive queue lock, temporary-file fsync, atomic rename and directory fsync protect committed ciphertext batches. Deduplication compares complete ciphertext, not caller-selected identifiers. Only durable helper acceptance or retirement removes a committed prefix.

Wall-clock expiry retires waiting/approved/approved_unused requests, scrubs retained payload/results and emits a cancellation with a fresh delivery window. Execution rechecks the original decision signature, required level, nonce/expiry and live device authority; sleep does not permit T2 to become Quick.

Execution is claimed under the state lock before calling the runner. Duplicate decisions cannot blindly execute again. A crash after the claim can produce no execution or lose a result; this is not proof of end-to-end exactly-once delivery.

An incoming undecided ApprovalRequest is stored only in State.inbound_requests, which is empty on helper startup. RelayInbound can return ack=true and retire relay delivery after this in-memory acceptance. A later helper restart can lose the undecided approver request. Ordinary sleep retaining process memory does not exercise this failure boundary.
